note: The base sells term personal loans and home loans. It has no overdraft and no wallet balance. REG-081 says an app must not hold the customer's money. REG-007 bars a default-loss guarantee on a revolving line. REG-074 leaves a credit line on UPI with banks and small finance banks, not NBFCs. CMP-11 is the Kenya note that an overdraft in the payment flow outgrew a savings-linked loan. None of those rows is his limit.
